# M1 Aviation

> M1 Aviation is the next-generation digital ecosystem for business aviation, uniting an AI-powered pre-owned aircraft marketplace, SIOS (Super Intelligent Operating System), and an elite vetted industry partner alliance.

## Core Platform & Solutions

- [M1 Marketplace](https://m1-aviation-website.vercel.app/marketplace): Premier private jet marketplace offering verified listings, market intelligence, transparent escrow, and the proprietary 7-Step Assisted Acquisition process for buyers and sellers.
- [SIOS - Super Intelligent Operating System](https://m1-aviation-website.vercel.app/saios): AI-driven operating intelligence system that unifies aircraft telemetry, maintenance provenance, regulatory compliance, and operational decision-making into an autonomous digital layer.
- [Industry Partner Alliance](https://m1-aviation-website.vercel.app/industry-partner): Global network of accredited aviation brokers, maintenance facilities, and charter operators (including BN Aviation, Velari Jets, and 7IVS) providing verified transactional execution and preferred operational benefits.
- [AVI Times](https://m1-aviation-website.vercel.app/aviation-times): Authority research and market intelligence publication covering aerospace supply chains, VC investment trends in Avi-Tech, and autonomous aviation futures.

## Key Publications & Market Research

- [The Jet Bottleneck: The Fork in the Future of Aviation!](https://m1-aviation-website.vercel.app/aviation-times/jet-bottleneck-fork-future-aviation): September edition analyzing global OEM order backlogs exceeding 16,000 aircraft, supply chain shortages, and the strategic fork between overproduction and disciplined undersupply.
- [Bloom of Aviation - 2 Edition (VC Special)](https://m1-aviation-website.vercel.app/aviation-times/bloom-of-aviation-2-edition-vc-special): Venture capital analysis on business aviation market cycles, Peter Thiel, Palantir's aviation software expansion, and tech investment in autonomous aerospace.
- [Future of Private Aviation](https://m1-aviation-website.vercel.app/aviation-times/future-of-private-aviation-man-manual): Strategic overview examining why aircraft management will transition from manual spreadsheets and paper records to AI and DePIN systems.
